scenarios.name: Cross-Tenant Object-Reference Mutation (BOLA)
scenarios.injection: Caller with tenant 'bank_beta' attempts to read, mutate status, or generate SAR for a case belonging to 'bank_alpha'
scenarios.expected_outcome: HTTP 403 Forbidden with zero mutation to database or timeline

scenarios.name: Stale Update Race Condition (Lost Update Prevention)
scenarios.injection: Two analysts read state S0='open'. Analyst 1 transitions to S1='investigating'. Analyst 2 submits update with expected_status='open'
scenarios.expected_outcome: Analyst 2 request fails with HTTP 409 Conflict ('Precondition failed: Expected case status')
scenarios.actual_outcome: HTTP 409 Conflict returned; case remains in 'investigating' without corruption

scenarios.name: Self-Approval Evasion via Casing & Prefix Variation
scenarios.injection: Assigned investigator 'john_doe' attempts to sign closure as 'supervisor:JOHN_DOE'
scenarios.expected_outcome: HTTP 403 Forbidden ('Self-approval prohibited: Assigned investigator cannot approve their own case')
scenarios.actual_outcome: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned; clean_identity normalizes identity and blocks bypass

scenarios.name: Terminal State Mutation Leak (Replay Resistance)
scenarios.injection: Attempt to link new alert, reassign, or reopen a case in 'closed_confirmed' status
scenarios.expected_outcome: TerminalCaseImmutableError raised; case remains finalized and immutable
scenarios.actual_outcome: TerminalCaseImmutableError successfully raised across all mutation vectors

scenarios.name: Regulatory SAR Generation for False Positive Case
scenarios.injection: Client requests FinCEN SAR XML generation for a case resolved as 'closed_false_positive'
scenarios.expected_outcome: HTTP 400 Bad Request ('Cannot generate SAR filing for a case resolved as CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE')
scenarios.actual_outcome: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned; fail-closed behavior verified

scenarios.name: Arbitrary Non-Existent UUID Synthesis Trap
scenarios.injection: Client queries a valid RFC-4122 UUID4 that does not exist in Redis
scenarios.expected_outcome: HTTP 404 Not Found without synthesizing a fake mock case

scenarios.name: Webhook SSRF DNS Resolution Failure (Fail-Closed)
scenarios.injection: Client registers target URL pointing to non-existent or internal unresolvable domain
scenarios.expected_outcome: ValueError / registration rejected upfront under fail-closed policy
scenarios.actual_outcome: Registration rejected ('Invalid or disallowed webhook target URL')

scenarios.name: Webhook Retries and Kafka Redelivery Deduplication
scenarios.injection: Dispatch event called multiple times for the same alert payload to simulate Kafka redelivery
scenarios.expected_outcome: Both dispatches carry the exact same deterministic X-CFI-Event-Id
scenarios.actual_outcome: Exact same 'evt_<hash>' returned across all deliveries
